subtitle: Out Manila · Juneyao Airlines
overview: Fly Juneyao Airlines from Manila to Shanghai for Nanjing Road, the Bund and Xinchang Ancient Town, then on to Jeju Island, South Korea. Jeju days include Seongsan Ilchulbong, Haenyeo Village, Hallasan 1100 Highland, Osulloc Tea Museum and K-drama filming locations. You return via Shanghai’s 1192 Old Shanghai Style Street. This is a shopping-stop package and is not suited to Muslim travellers.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 5–10 2026 to Mar 13–18 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's famous pedestrian shopping street, busy with stores, restaurants and neon lights.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade lined with historic buildings, facing the skyscrapers of Pudong.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: Shanghai's landmark TV tower with its distinctive spheres, seen on a photo stop from The Bund.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: A Taoist temple in Shanghai's old city, set among traditional-style shops and lanes.
placeDesc.Xinchang Ancient Town: A historic water town near Shanghai with canals, old bridges and traditional houses.
placeDesc.Iho Tewoo Horse Lighthouse: Horse-shaped lighthouses on a Jeju beach, a popular photo spot and filming location.
placeDesc.Dodu Rainbow Coastal Road: A colorful coastal road on Jeju's north shore, near Dodubong Peak, popular for photos.
placeDesc.Yongduam Rock: A dragon-head-shaped volcanic rock formation on Jeju's coast near Jeju City.
placeDesc.Seongsan Ilchulbong: A dramatic volcanic crater on Jeju's east coast, a UNESCO World Heritage site known for sunrise views.
placeDesc.Haenyeo Village: A Jeju coastal village associated with the haenyeo, the island's traditional women free-divers.
placeDesc.Seongeup Folk Village: A preserved traditional Jeju village of thatched-roof houses and stone walls.
placeDesc.Arboretum Night Market: An evening market in Jeju with street food and local snacks.
placeDesc.Gwaneumsa Temple: A well-known Buddhist temple on Jeju Island, on the slopes of Hallasan.
placeDesc.Hallasan 1100 Highland: A high-altitude wetland and rest area on the Hallasan road, known for scenery and views.
placeDesc.Dongmun Traditional Market: Jeju City's largest traditional market, selling fresh seafood, produce and local snacks.
placeDesc.Osulloc Tea Museum: A Jeju tea museum and tea-field estate where visitors taste green tea and tea desserts.
placeDesc.Oedolgae Rock: A tall single sea stack standing off Jeju's southern coast, a famous scenic landmark.
placeDesc.Olle Trail: A walking trail along Jeju's coastline, visited for a short coastal stroll.
placeDesc.1192 Old Shanghai Style Street: A Shanghai street styled after old Shanghai, with shops, food and photo spots, visited on the last day.
